project_summary: The project is focused on delivering real-time subtitles and memory support through a phone-first architecture, while maintaining social acceptability and minimizing battery impact. The current cycle has seen clear progress in subtitle clarity, memory trust, and low-friction assistive behavior, but faces ongoing tensions around privacy vs usefulness and latency vs richness.

dimensions.label: Hardware Stack
dimensions.goal: Keep V1 lightweight, discreet, socially acceptable, and dependent on minimal on-glasses compute.
dimensions.progress_summary: The glasses are designed to remain lightweight and use minimal on-glasses processing, aligning with the goal.
dimensions.next_focus: Continue focusing on minimizing battery usage and thermal management for always-on features.

dimensions.label: Software Stack
dimensions.goal: Keep the cognition stack practical, maintainable, and centered on subtitle quality, memory trust, and low-friction assistive behavior.
dimensions.progress_summary: The project is actively working on improving subtitle clarity, confidence display, and memory caching, which are key to the software stack goals.
dimensions.next_focus: Define specific implementation details for recency-first cache policy and balanced phone/cloud fallback.

dimensions.label: Wireless Interface
dimensions.goal: Keep the glasses-phone link reliable enough for phone-first processing without making V1 fragile.
dimensions.progress_summary: The TranscriptLab app is being used to validate real-time transcript behavior, but connection stability remains an open question.
dimensions.next_focus: Conduct more thorough testing of the glasses-phone link in various usage scenarios to ensure reliability.

dimensions.label: Firmware
dimensions.goal: Keep firmware simple, robust, and aligned with touch-first input and lightweight display behavior.
dimensions.progress_summary: The firmware is designed to be simple but effective, focusing on basic functionality.
dimensions.next_focus: Refine the firmware implementation for touch-first input to ensure robustness without overcomplicating it.

dimensions.label: Subtitle System
dimensions.goal: Deliver near-real-time, readable subtitles with trust-preserving visual behavior.
dimensions.progress_summary: Subtitle clarity is being tested and refined, ensuring that subtitles remain clear and readable during live interactions.
dimensions.next_focus: Continue optimizing the subtitle display logic to ensure high readability and trustworthiness.

dimensions.label: Memory System
dimensions.goal: Support fast, trustworthy face/name recall and conversation memory without storing too much low-value information.
dimensions.progress_summary: The project is working on implementing a recency-first cache policy to improve face/name recall accuracy.
dimensions.next_focus: Define specific implementation details for the memory system, ensuring that it supports fast lookup while respecting privacy concerns.

dimensions.label: Privacy And Trust
dimensions.goal: Help the wearer understand better without faking understanding, while keeping privacy and consent pressure visible.
dimensions.progress_summary: While there is a focus on building trust through clear confidence displays and accurate memory support, the balance between utility and privacy remains an unresolved contradiction.
dimensions.next_focus: Develop more concrete strategies for surface privacy limits early and ensure that all interactions remain transparent to the user.
